rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c='%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_dmht_ckd_acei_arb(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  splevel varchar(2) DEFAULT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target1 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  result1 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  target2 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  result2 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  target3 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  result3 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  target4 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  result4 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  target int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  result int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
DELETE FROM s_dmht_ckd_acei_arb WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dmht_ckd_acei_arb 
(
SELECT
@id,l.HOSPCODE,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode,null as splevel
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(quarter IN(1)  ,CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),null)) t1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.quarter in(1) AND l.acei_arb in(1) ,CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),null)) r1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(quarter IN(2)  ,CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),null)) t2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.quarter in(2) AND l.acei_arb in(1) ,CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),null)) r2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(quarter IN(3)  ,CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),null)) t3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.quarter in(3) AND l.acei_arb in(1) ,CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),null)) r3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(quarter IN(4)  ,CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),null)) t4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(l.quarter in(4) AND l.acei_arb in(1) ,CONCAT(l.hospcode,'-',l.pid),null)) r4
,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(y.hospcode,'-',y.pid)) t
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(y.acei_arb in(1) ,CONCAT(y.hospcode,'-',y.pid),null)) r

FROM
 t_ckd_service_lastq l INNER JOIN t_ckd_service_last y ON l.hospcode=y.hospcode AND l.pid=y.pid
INNER JOIN t_dmht d ON  d.cid=y.cid
INNER JOIN chospital h ON h.hoscode=l.HOSPCODE AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15)
WHERE l.nation in(99) AND
/*stage1-4*/
  (
      LEFT(l.DIAGCODE,4) IN ('N181','N182','N183','N184')
		 OR  LEFT(l.DIAGCODE,4) IN ('N189') AND ( l.egfr_ok=0 OR  l.egfr_ok>=15)

     OR ((LEFT(l.DIAGCODE,4) IN ('E102','E112','E122','E132','E142','I151','N083')
             OR LEFT(l.DIAGCODE,3) IN ('I12','I13','I12','I13','N02','N03','N04','N05','N06','N07','N08','N11','N13','N14','N20','N21','N22','N23'))
             AND  l.egfr_ok>=15)
     ) 
GROUP BY l.HOSPCODE
);

rows.notice:
จำนวนผู้ป่วยโรคไตเรื้อรัง Stage 1-4 หมายถึง ผู้ป่วยจากแฟ้ม DIAGNOSIS_OPD ที่มีรหัสโรคเป็น
1. N181-184
2. N189 ที่ไม่มี eGFR หรือมี eGFR>=15
3. E102,E112,E122,E132,E142,I151,N083,I12*,I13*,I12*,I13*,N02*,N03*,N04*,N05*,N06*,N07*,N08*,N11*,N13*,N14*,N20*,N21*,N22*,N23* ที่มี eGFR>= 15
คำนวน Stage เมื่อสิ้นสุดไตรมาส
ได้รับ ACEi/ARB หมายถึง รหัสตามมาตรฐานที่สมาคมกำหนด
*** นับคนไม่ซ้ำในไตรมาส ยอดรวมทั้งปีนับคนไม่ซ้ำในปี
rows.indiv_sql:
SET @prov_c := ( SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1 );
SET @b_year := ( SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1 );
SET @start_d := concat( @b_year - 1, '1001' );
SET @end_d := concat( @b_year, '0930' );
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF	NOT EXISTS tx (
	SELECT SQL_BIG_RESULT
		h.hoscode,h.hosname,	p.PID,p.CID,	p.NAME,p.LNAME,p.SEX,p.BIRTH
		,p.HID,	p.addr,p.check_vhid,p.NATION,	p.TYPEAREA,y.d_acei_arb,d.DIDSTD,d.DNAME
		,IF	( y.acei_arb IN ( 1 ), "พบข้อมูลรหัสยา", "ไม่พบข้อมูล" ) AS result 
		,y.DIAGCODE,y.d_egfr_ok d_egfr,y.egfr_ok egfr
	FROM t_ckd_service_last y 
			INNER JOIN chospital h ON h.hoscode =y.HOSPCODE 
			AND h.provcode IN ( @prov_c ) 		AND h.hdc_regist = 1 		AND h.hostype IN ( 5, 6, 7, 11,12,15 )
		INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON y.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND y.PID=p.PID
		INNER JOIN t_dmht dh ON  dh.cid=y.cid
		LEFT JOIN tmp_drug_opd d ON y.HOSPCODE=d.hospcode 
							AND y.PID=d.pid AND y.d_acei_arb=d.date_serv AND
(     d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]0061[7-9]'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]0062[1-3]'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]23171'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]24354'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]24432'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]24831'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]24843'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]24860'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]24889'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]24976'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]44080'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]030902500[39]'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]03090[1-2]0001'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]0309025005'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]0309040005'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]0309025007'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]0309040001'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]0309025008'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]030902500[1246]'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]0309040003'
      OR d.DIDSTD REGEXP '^[0-9]0309023001'
      ) AND y.acei_arb IN(1)
	WHERE		y.nation IN ( 99 ) 
		AND /*stage1-4*/
		(
			LEFT ( y.DIAGCODE, 4 ) IN ( 'N181', 'N182', 'N183', 'N184' ) 
			OR LEFT ( y.DIAGCODE, 4 ) IN ( 'N189' ) 
			AND ( y.egfr_ok = 0 OR y.egfr_ok >= 15 ) 
			OR (
				(
					LEFT ( y.DIAGCODE, 4 ) IN ( 'E102', 'E112', 'E122', 'E132', 'E142', 'I151', 'N083' ) 
					OR LEFT ( y.DIAGCODE, 3 ) IN ('I12',	'I13','I12','I13','N02','N03','N04','N05','N06','N07','N08','N11','N13','N14','N20','N21','N22','N23' 
					) 
				) 
				AND y.egfr_ok >= 15 
			) 
		) 
	GROUP BY p.HOSPCODE,p.PID
	);
SELECT
	p.hoscode,	p.hosname,p.PID,p.CID,p.NAME,p.LNAME,p.SEX,p.BIRTH,p.HID,p.addr,p.check_vhid,p.NATION,p.TYPEAREA
	,p.d_acei_arb,p.result ,p.DIDSTD,p.DNAME		,p.DIAGCODE,p.d_egfr,p.egfr
FROM tx p 
WHERE 1 = 1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("target1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("result1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("target2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("result2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("target3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("result3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("target4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("result4") as "resultq4"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
